visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a festive gold and red title card featuring two red paper-cut horse graphics representing the year of the horse. The title text is displayed prominently at the top while circular bubbles containing images of various gourmet dishes float over a gold background decorated with traditional wave patterns. (2) A close-up shot presents a dish of red curry with fried fish, zucchini, and a generous topping of pink sakura shrimp in a white bowl. The camera slightly pans to show the vibrant textures of the food against a red festive tablecloth. (3) The scene shifts to a bamboo steamer filled with savory sticky rice, topped with sliced red sausages, mushrooms, and peanuts. A pair of chopsticks enters the frame to pick up a cluster of the rice and toppings, highlighting the sticky consistency. (4) A white ceramic pot containing a dark silkie chicken soup with mushrooms and dried radish is shown. A white spoon scoops up a piece of the black chicken and various herbs, showcasing the depth and richness of the broth. (5) A plate of stir-fried vegetables with sliced lotus roots, red dates, and mushrooms is presented. Orange chopsticks lift a glossy slice of lotus root to demonstrate the appetizing glaze and crisp texture of the dish. (6) A large, slow-braised pork knuckle in a dark savory sauce is garnished with broccoli and star-cut carrots. The meat is tenderly separated by chopsticks, revealing the soft interior and glazed skin. (7) A white ceramic jar for 'Buddha Jumps Over the Wall' soup is featured, with a spoon digging into the broth to reveal premium ingredients such as abalone, taro, and pork pieces. (8) A dessert bowl of dark purple rice and red bean soup is shown. A spoon lifts the thick, sweet soup to show the blend of textures. (9) The final screen presents a summary of all seven dishes, the promotional price, and the early bird ordering dates, alongside headshot portraits of six professional chefs credited for the recipes.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with festive traditional Chinese instrumental music featuring prominent gongs and rhythmic drums at a fast tempo (130 BPM). The spectral balance is bright, setting an energetic and celebratory tone without vocals. (2) A professional male narrator enters with high energy and clarity, articulating each word with an upbeat promotional tone. He introduces the Lunar New Year food set while the festive BGM continues at a slightly lower volume level in the background. (3) As the visual transitions through different dishes, the narrator describes each one with increasing intensity and rising intonation at the ends of phrases. The music maintains its steady rhythmic pulse, providing a continuous harmonic foundation. (4) The narrator moves into the promotional details, including pricing and dates, using a persuasive and authoritative speech pattern. A subtle 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies the visual transition of the text boxes on screen. (5) The video concludes with the narrator stating the final call to action. The background music swells in volume to a percussive climax, finishing with a final drum hit as the track fades out cleanly.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a commercial advertisement for a Lunar New Year banquet food set titled '瑞馬迎春鴻運套組' from the brand '型男大主廚'. It combines high-quality close-up food cinematography with energetic narration and festive music to entice viewers to purchase the set during the early bird promotion period. The intent is to highlight the quality and convenience of the pre-prepared festive meal.
